title: ChatGPT paste import verified
summary: Paste labeled text or JSON, review detected fields and fill the product form without an API call.

changes.detail: Open-by-default ChatGPT paste panel above link import. Supports French/English labels, JSON, bold labels, headings and two-column tables, with field preview and selection before applying.

Maps product name, brand, description, category, MAD price, original price, stock, tags and kg weight. Missing/empty fields are preserved; unsupported fields, currencies and ambiguous units produce warnings. No external AI call, persistence or publishing.
Applying a pasted name derives a slug only for new products; existing product URLs remain intact. Existing link import and writing assistant remain available.

validation.name: Parser and interaction tests
validation.detail: Seven tests passed: labeled multiline text, JSON, markdown tables/headings, zero stock, invalid values/units, omitted fields, selected-field application and invalidation of stale previews.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused lint
validation.detail: Full repository TypeScript check passed. Product editor, paste component and parser lint passed without warnings or errors.

validation.name: History integrity
validation.detail: Manifest check passed and all existing reports retained.

validation.name: Browser and deployment
validation.detail: No visual browser verification or deployment. Import accepts labeled text/JSON rather than interpreting unrestricted prose; unsupported fields are reported for manual entry.
